summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stashorra phone price calculator app. Frontend UI/UX works perfectly with proper black/white theme, all navigation flows, and condition assessment. Backend APIs are functional but web scraping returns empty results due to anti-bot measures. AI integration has import/method issues causing fallback to basic estimation.

critical_bugs.issue: Web scraping returns 0 prices from both Slot.ng and Jiji.ng
critical_bugs.impact: No market data for price estimation, affects accuracy
critical_bugs.details: Jiji.ng returns 403 Forbidden, Slot.ng returns 200 but finds no products due to anti-bot measures

critical_bugs.issue: AI integration failing - incorrect import and method calls for emergentintegrations.llm.openai
critical_bugs.impact: Falls back to basic mathematical estimation instead of AI-powered analysis
critical_bugs.details: LlmChat initialization and response parsing issues

working_endpoints.status: Working correctly - returns 6 brands with models
Returns estimates using fallback calculation when AI fails

integration_issues.issue: Estimated price shows 'N/A' when no market data available

passed_tests: Landing page loads with Stashorra branding and black/white theme
Brand dropdown shows available phone brands (Apple, Samsung, etc.)
Model dropdown populates correctly when brand is selected
Search button triggers /api/search-phone endpoint and navigates to estimate page
Condition assessment page shows 3 steps (screen, battery, damage)
Condition selection works for all 3 steps with proper data-testid attributes
Submit triggers /api/estimate-price and navigates to results page
Results page displays receipt-style estimate layout
All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Features section displays correctly with all three feature cards
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix web scraping anti-bot issues by implementing proper headers, delays, and possibly rotating user agents. Fix AI integration by correcting emergentintegrations.llm.openai import and response parsing. Web scraping may need alternative approach or proxy services.

success_percentage.backend: 70% - APIs work but scraping and AI integration have issues
success_percentage.frontend: 95% - All UI flows work perfectly, minor display issue with N/A prices
